title: Small-Group Tour of Colosseum Underground, Arena and Forum
description: Access parts of the Colosseum that are usually off limits to the general public on a behind-the-scenes tour that also includes a skip-the-line admission ticket. As well as saving hours of waiting in line, you’ll benefit from the insider knowledge of your guide via a headset, which ensures you can hear commentary clearly.

reviews.usertext:
My 17-year-old travel companion had chosen Italy as the destination for our trip together and specified the Colosseum as their main point of interest in Rome. It seemed essential to take the tour with exclusive access to the Underground area, where the animals were kept before being raised to the arena floor and gladiators used to mingle. Our guide, Lia with Touriks, met us outside the Colosseo Metro Station, escorted us across the street and through the entrance and security lines. We toured the underground area, the arena floor, and even walked along some of the exhibits on the upper level. She enlivened her speaking tour with drama and sound effects to try to bring the scene of nearly 2000 years ago to life. She then took us on a tour of the Forum, ending at the overlook on Palatine Hill. She made sure that we all knew where we could fill our water bottles and gave us time to do so several times. The teenager later told me that he really enjoyed this tour because of how engaging and entertaining Lia was. I appreciated how knowledgeable and informative she was. The tour lasted almost exactly three hours.

Lia also was very helpful recommending restaurants in Rome, suggesting where people might go to eat for lunch or dinner after the tour. When she found out that we would be traveling next to Sorrento, she even recommended an excellent restaurant there for us to visit!

My only complaint was regarding the pricing. We booked this tour through GetYourGuide, who advertises this attraction at $93 per person, but it actually cost $106 pp in early June, and appears to now be priced higher (~$112 pp). Be very careful when booking - it turns out the "cheap" rates are for much shorter tours. They should advertise the shorter and longer tours separately and provide accurate pricing for each.

We participated in this tour on Sunday 18th September 2022.
The tour commenced @ 15.00 pm and our guide named Daniel no. 5 was excellent. He was knowledgeable, kept the group together and at a comfortable pace around the ruins to allow plenty of time for photos and to take in the historical landmarks.

We also felt that when you consider how ridiculously busy the Colosseum is, this tour gave us a small amount of space and separation from the crowds which enhanced the experience and made for easier photography.
Definitely book the underground tour in advance as it is extremely popular and sells out.
To avoid the heat I would recommend booking an early morning or late afternoon tour as there are periods of direct exposure to the elements.
The underground component was really amazing and takes your imagination on a wild ride of all the historical possibilities that may have taken place.
We would definitely recommend this tour.

Going by myself and using the little radio as I walk and want to explore more about specific arts, I recommend you to go by yourself if you can. Much better than those crowded groups, you need to wait for someone, and you don't spend time with quality learning about that art. The museum is clean and exciting. Don't buy tickets with strangers on the street. I hope you have fun.

I really did not like this tour. I would absolutely not recommend it if you can do an Audio guide or another tour group. I actually really wanted to ask for my money back. And I feel terrible saying this but our tour guide should not have been a tour guide, either he was not comfortable speaking English or he didn't know what he was talking about as far as the Colosseum goes. He would say "anyways" in the middle of explaining something he must've said it about 100 times at least. Along with asking us to pay attention to something when we were all staring at him and then he'd give some non important fact after saying pay attention. He didn't know how to answer most of our questions and there was almost no tenacity with his teachings, he would just go into saying something then move onto something else and it was very confusing and difficult to understand anything. Like I said definitely not worth almost $300 for two people. We were just praying for the tour to end to go to anything else in Rome. The colosseum itself was really neat, I'm glad I went I just wish I had other means or another tour to see it.

This access all areas tour with Gabriel was truly amazing and worth the price tag: as an archaeologist, the depth and breadth of Gabriel's knowledge was superb; he was also humorous and personable making the tour all the more enjoyable. The scale of the Colosseum is breathtaking; access to the underground areas and arena and discussion about how the arena was operated completed the picture and, in our view, should not be missed. A great tour.

We easily found the meetup location early and met our guide.
Sarah was our teacher for three plus hours, just me and my wife were in the group. We felt like royalty as many other groups had 10-15 people in it. Sarah is educated, friendly, and passionate about Rome and Italy in general. We were provided a headset and off we went, directly passing everyone to the bottom area of the Coliseum. We went bottom up and seen every aspect of this magnificent structure.

It appeared all the security and gatekeepers knew Sarah as we approached they opened lines for us to pass. We were waived at many bottlenecks to pass through lines as if we were on our own trip.

The depth of understanding Sarah had was apparent and her delivery was engaging and interactive. She came with pictures from an albulm for further clarity and understanding that she whipped out of her bag.

The tour is impressive, spectacular, and leaves you with an appreciation of how remarkable this place is and the people who erected it. I would highly recommend this tour.

From the Coliseum you go to the arches nearby and then to see one of the early emperors private reaidence. Then you are brought down into the valley and everything is put into perspective.

Dont miss this trip, you wont regret it.

The worst part of our trip. $240 for 2 in a “small” group of 20 people. The guide rushes you as fast as possible so they can get to the next tour, our “guide” actually tried to cut out tour short and skip half the colosseum! Our whole group was kind of stunned, so we protested, and she acted shocked “oh you want to go up the stairs??” Yeah. Obviously we do. We wanted to look in the gift shop but were not allowed, we had to stay with the group and rush right out the exit. No re-entry. Then a rushed walk through the forum, I talked with multiple people on our tour and we all left feeling really disappointed in the whole thing. Pay $16 to go at your own pace, the lines aren’t that bad.

We really enjoyed our private tour with Sara! She was so enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the culture and history all around us. She answered all of our questions—including several from my young kids on obscure topics—and navigated the crowd and heat really nicely by finding quiet shades spots to stop in and discuss the various sites. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a personalized experience in what is otherwise a very crowded and touristy area.

We attended this tour yesterday with Tourkis and we were guided by Serena around the Roman Forum, Palestine Hill and the Colosseum including the underground areas. We are so glad we went on this tour as we were part of a small group of 8 guests, so we all received a lot of attention from our guide who gave us lots of information and made the tour funny, enjoyable and relaxing - the time really flew by. When it comes to the Colosseum, the queues are very long indeed and when it says skip the line, you really do jump ahead of these long waiting times. Serena managed to get us to be the first group underground at the Colosseum and this part of the experience was what we had waited all week for - to see how the venue was operated, where the animals lived and how the gladiators entered the arena. Serena was also able to show us pictures of how the gladiators looked, what weapons they used in combat, how the fights were organised and also the other gruesome events that took place. She also revealed a fascinating thing that we didn’t know about the Colosseum which added a new dimension to how this venue was used, but we won’t spoil that surprise here. It was an amazing afternoon of discovery in warm sun with a great guide. Five stars.

We had an amazing tour, largely due to our tour guide Lia Caso from Touriks. First of all strolling in to these sites early and not being stuck in line or in crowds is worth every penny. Even though there were other groups doing various tours, when we were doing the colosseum portion, at times I felt we were the only group there, especially during the underground portion of the tour. Our tour started at 9:30 at the Forum and another stop which took about 1.5 hours and ended with the colosseum portion of the tour. This was perfect because by 11am it was getting very hot out and doing the more “sun exposed” Forum part of the tour first was perfect. It wouldn’t have been fun doing the Forum at 11am being much hotter and more crowded than earlier.

Lia was so bubbly and friendly, she made the tour very enjoyable. She is very knowledgeable and shared so many interesting facts throughout the tour of the Forum and Colosseum. Seeing the underground was also fascinating. Even though there were other tours going on from other companies, there were many times I felt like our small group were the only ones there. Maybe they limit the groups doing the underground tour bc it felt very private even though the Colosseum overall was relatively crowded.

I’m very happy we did this tour and definitely recommend it and Lia If you can request her!

We signed up for ‘Guided Tour of Colosseum Underground, Arena and Forum’, so that we could access the underground of the Colosseum. It did not disappoint! You may only access this area with a tour guide and honestly.. you wouldn't want to wander without one! There is so much to learn and Pelin (our tour guide) was incredible!! We spent about 3 hours with her and she shared so much history not only about the Colosseum itself, but also about what life was like in Rome at the time. We also had access to the Forum and arena floor in the Colosseum. Again, you would not want to wander the Forum without a guide - you wouldn’t know what any of the ruins are. She also allowed us to stop to take photos as well - we didn’t feel rushed. Booking a tour of the Colosseum and Forum is the way to go and I highly, highly recommend Pelin!

Definitely recommend this tour, our tour guide Francesca was absolutely brilliant, so engaging and answered all the questions our group asked her, she is incredibly knowledgeable! Really well organised too.
We had a really great time throughout the whole trip, seeing parts of the Colosseum that you couldn't usually is very worth it and the tour of the Roman Forum and Palatine hill is an added bonus! In my opinion this tour is very good value for money for what you get out of it and definitely worth going in a small group to truly appreciate what's around you without a crowd. 11/10 experience, thank you so much, the tour will be a top highlight of our trip to Rome!

If you want to really understand and visualize what a massive accomplishment the building of the Colosseum was at the time, you need a tour guide. Secondly to get the proper perspective, of the hundreds of individuals required to make all the systems work as designed. Starting underground, gives you views of the gladiators waiting areas and the animal holding pens and hoists to the arena floor. With a little imagination you can almost hear the 60,000 Romans cheering as the lions and gladiators fought for their lives.

We booked to go on a tour with max 8 people and ended up having to go with 21 people and one tour guide. We were not impressed as we paid for a more personal tour with only 8 people altogether and we had no other choice but to go on a tour with 21 people. We were offered a refund of the difference in price but I feel this is not acceptable as we arrived in Rome hoping for a more personal tour. That is what we paid for!

Inge led our family of 5, including three teenagers, on a detailed tour of the colosseum underground, the arena, and the forum. She had a ton of knowledge on all fronts, and did a great job of keeping the kids engaged with colorful anecdotes, getting some good family pictures, and adjusting to the rain / weather conditions. We had some stragglers try to “join” our private tour and she politely sent them along. The microphone / earpiece was helpful so that we could catch everything without always hovering. All in all, very good experience.

I have visited the Colloseum and the Forum before without a tour guide and felt a little bit underwhelmed, so for this return trip I decided to get a private tour. It was well worth the money. My guide Serena really brought Ancient Rome to life. A qualified art historian she had a real passion for the place and could answer every question I had. Standing in the Forum 25 years ago it had seemed like and interesting, but confusing collection of relics, but with Serena’s descriptions and her pictures of reconstructions I was awestruck by the scale and grandeur of the ancient Roman capital. If you are interested in Ancient Rome and really want to get a sense of what it was really like, I highly recommend getting a private tour with a skilled guide like Serena.

Our guide, Sara, was incredible! She was very knowledgeable of ancient Roman history, and her storytelling was a delight. I enjoyed her sense of humor, which made the tour that much more fun and lively. Loved being able to see the Colosseum's underground...such a treat. Our tour started at 9am...highly recommend going early! We were first underground and had the place to ourselves for a while. I definitely and highly recommend this tour!

We limited our Rome guided tours to two, and felt we had made a great decision in booking this one. Manola was excellent - very professional, well organised, faultless English, and brought the sites and sights to life with great descriptions. She connected excellently with our small group: vivid descriptions using the physical things we were looking at, references to popular fiction that surrounds these sites, and nice humour. The tour was packed, but not rushed.

What a wonderful way to explore the Colosseo, Roman Forum, and the underground area!! Our tour guide Fernando was very knowledgeable, friendly, and had great energy even in the summer heat. It was great being able to stroll around so many areas and learn about the history from a guide that made the time pass at a perfect pace. I would recommend this tour to all of my friends given the depth of areas covered and the quality of Fernando professionalism in getting us to where we needed to go in a timely manner. Overall, fantastic way to tour the Colosseo for anyone!

Book. This. Tour.

The underground area only allows a certain number of visitors each day, so book as far in advance as you are able. Our tour consisted of only 3 of us; me, my mom, and another gentlemen.

Let me say this tour was made extremely special by our tour guide, Adriana. The underground area is extremely fascinating and she focused on the science and engineering involved in the Coloseum, as well as, speaking of the battles that took place there and the many uses the space was used for throughout history. You then get to walk the main floor as well as the different levels. This is of course if they are all open and not under refurbishment. We were lucky that the only level that wasn't available was the very top, but that was more than okay since the underground and main floor was the biggest highlight of the Colosseum. For the majority of the Colosseum tour we used special VIP routes to avoid the crowds.

Adrian then gave us a choice: continue to forum or we could to the Palatine Hill. If your tour guide gives you this option, and your enjoy history, you MUST choose the Palatine Hill. You get so much more information about the area as well as stroll through the beautiful park. A major highlight is that at the top of the hill you get the most stunning view of all of Rome overlooking the Forum. Adriana then did the part of the Forum tour from above. By this point in the tour the other gentlemen had left to catch a train and so me and my mom had this lovely private tour with our guide.

Adriana was so extremely friendly and passionate about her job and history. It showed with every carefully chosen fact and story she told. It was just like walking through a park chatting with a good friend you haven't seen in a long time. I would highly recommend this tour and requesting Adriana is a MUST!

We had older teens, when we arrived we were told the entry staff at the the Colosseum might ask for ID, you might need to take a passport or photograph of passport. Thankfully, didn’t cause an issue for us.

We arrived late as we got lost in the city and we’re very stressed as we had missed our tour. Thankfully, crown tours were running regular tours and just put us in the next one without fuss, we were very grateful.

Jan was our guide and had so much knowledge. He happily answered questions from the group and showed us all he could in the time we had. Once we had finished, we were still inside the forum so could then go back and revisit everything if we wished. Jan managed very well, we had group members with mobility issues and he managed to help them sensitively without holding back the rest of the group.

I would highly recommend this tour.

The underground Colosseum tour was absolutely fascinating! Isida has a complete understanding of the building and everything that went on inside of it back to when it was built. She may have dispelled some Gladiator fantasies that Hollywood would like us to believe, but I appreciated the honest truth about what the games and life at that time were actually like. I would absolutely recommend anyone to go with Isida and the Touriks group, they definitely know what they're doing. Thank you, Touriks!

Excellent tour. DanielV our guide had extensive knowledge and a good sense of humour. He held the attention of the group throughout and was audible at all times. He made frequent stops to ensure the group were together before delivering new information, which he did in a contextual and interesting way.
Needless to say, the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Forum are of great interest per se, but the guide made it an excellent experience.

We had our hotel find and book a tour for us so we didn’t know what to expect. We were told to meet in front of the metro half an hour before, and the girl with the sign was easy to find. One woman checked for everyone’s reservations and showed them to their guides. They couldn’t find ours and instead of brushing us off, she quickly resolved it by contacting their office person or whatever and everything was fine. Laura was our tour guide and she was great. It was a hot day (100 degrees) so she made sure everyone had or bought water before we started. She also showed everyone fountains during the tour to refill. The tour was everything we wanted. Started with palatine hill, to the forum, then to the colosseum and the underground (what we were most looking forward to!). Our tour guide was very knowledgeable, pleasant, made sure to stop in the shade when possible, and had answers to everyone’s questions. We had those little speaker/ear bud things to make sure we could always hear her. She also made sure everyone got the pictures they wanted and offered to take them. The entire tour lasted about 2.5 hours. Would def reccomend

Giovanni from Touriks guided us excellently through the Colusseum including it's underground area and on Palatine Hill and through the forum in about 3 hours. He was great at structuring his story, spoken in fluent English and with a good sence of humor. He cathered to the requests from the group, adjusting his walk and storyline in such a way that we saw more than expected. We had enough time to make photos everywhere and even go to the bathroom at Palatine Hill. The audio system allows you to look around a bit more without missing parts of his story. The company organized this tour well, the security and Covid checkpoints didn't delay us much and the hostess at the Colluseum allowed our group to move around with Giovanni without many restrictions. I would highly recommend Touriks and this guide. Only point of improvement would be at GetYourGuide, their description of where to meet the guide is accurate but the area seems a bit disorganized due to other tourguides trying to get clients in the same area. They tell you to look for "the local partner" but they don't mention the name of that partner on their voucher. I eventually found a Touriks employee (recognized by their logo on a yellow sticker of their clipboard) after 15 minutes. He was not visible when we arrived, he was understandably hiding in the shadow of the green kiosk.

we did this tour and i will say it was the most paid back relaxing tour i have ever had, our guide, Selena was so informative and sweet I highly recommend if you can get on her tours you must do it! she will go at a pace that is not too fast or slow it is a perfect walk and you walk for 3 plus hours. she had all the answers to question our small group had and even more along with history and current present day information. I cannot say enough about how much we enjoyed this tour, even if we had to watch out for all the Fast and Furious filming lol

We visiting Rome, we chose Touriks for tours of the Colosseum and Vatican City. The guides for the tours (Gabriel-Colosseum and Marco-Vatican City) were very knowledgeable and made the tours enjoyable. Touriks has lots of options for tours so there is bound to be one that fits what you are interested in. At the Colosseum, we did the underground tour. I highly recommend that as it’s incredibly cool to think that gladiators were walking those hallways thousands of years ago.

Easy to find meet up. Welcome guides friendly helpful and started on time. Tour operator told us in advance that we Could not do underground section given rain, disappointing given there were still clearly tours happening in the underground section during our visit. In addition I dont appear to have had the partial refund promised. Tour itself felt too rushed. I have done many many walking tours and this was the most rushed ever. Our focus was simply to try and keep up with the guide who moved on too quickly at every point. 2 of our group spent 20mins picking up the German tour as they couldn't keep close enough to our English speaking guide. We were really unable to appreciate the view and surroundings. A real disappointment.

We had an absolutely amazing time touring and learning all about the Colosseum. Helena (Elena) did an absolutely outstanding job walking us through, explaining the history, answering any and all questions we had throughout the tour. We were thoroughly entertained! We will recommend this tour to all family and friends coming to Rome on vacation to have as fantastic of an experience as we did today!

This was the best part of our trip to Rome for all of us! Pelin was a fantastic guide who kept us all fascinated for the whole tour. Pelin’s English was perfect, she made the tour fun and so interesting and could answer any questions (she clearly has a tremendous depth of knowledge). The Colosseum in particular is stunning but I don’t think you can fully appreciate it and understand the gladiators without a guide. The tour had all the things you’ve always wanted to know about the Colosseum. Most incredibly my teenagers who had been apprehensive about having a tour guide loved it. Pelin kept their interest for the whole 3 hour tour and they’ve kept saying how good it was and how glad they are that we did it!

Serena, our tour guide, was both a treasure trove of information and a treasure of a human being.

She matched her style to us perfectly, bringing a candor and a point of view that brought to life the history, the story, and the realities of politics, power and society in Ancient Rome and through the ages.

We could have spent many more hours with Serena, but are so grateful for the hours we had with her.

The colosseum was, of course, amazing as was the Forum. Unfortunately we weren’t allowed to visit the underground sections of the colosseum but we don’t feel like we missed out at all. Such is touring in Italy.

Pro Tips: read the instructions on your confirmation closely. The meeting place isn’t obvious—near a green kiosk in front of the Colosseum metro station. And ask for Serena!!!

Our guide, Massimo, was wonderful. He was very knowledgeable and thoughtful, especially on a hot day. He is a Roman, and obviously loves sharing about his city. I'd highly recommend this tour, and Massimo as the guide. Additionally, we had a booking error with a secondary site and Touriks was quick and very responsive in helping us settle the error; would highly recommend this company!

We loved this tour! We booked it because it included the Underground portion. Totally worth it! The tour guide was the best one we had the entire trip - a local Roman that clearly loves his heritage and city. Although the tour was quite long, it provided so much knowledge and insight into the Colosseum and Rome as it was back in the day. The Forum and Palatine Hill were beautiful - you can almost see Ancient Rome coming back to life. We only had one other family in our group for a total of 7 people ... very intimate and allowed us to ask a lot of questions. Definitely recommend this tour!

Elena made the entire experience unforgettable. Her passion, knowledge and kindness were riveting! She had all of us wanting to learn more and more. I’ve never enjoyed history so much as today. Elena also was so polite and kind to all the people she had to navigate us through. She was always concerned with us, reminding us to be careful and asking how we were all doing. It was hot but I am so grateful we took this tour today. Elena was very thoughtful of our time and I lived the way she brought out attention to specific ruins or views and tied them all into a beautiful picture. I cannot say enough about how wonderful she was. Our tour friends felt tge same as we did. There was 6 of us—perfect size to really enjoy the sites and each other.

My husband and I chose this tour as it seemed like the most immersive experience we could have at the Colosseum - not only were we not disappointed, but our expectations were exceeded. Our guide was Fernando, and not only was he extremely knowledgeable about the Roman history, he was also very willing to go in depth with answers for random visitor questions about the most esoteric things.

We had our tour in the morning and though the itinerary for the tour listed the Colosseum as our first stop, we actually entered the structure last - this was very beneficial as we had Palatine Hill to ourselves, enabling our small group of 5 people to spend a quiet morning absorbing the beauty of the ruins without the chaos of the crowds that were arriving as we finished. Our photo memories are gorgeous and not choked by throngs of people.

The underground portion of the Colosseum is a worthy addition and we were glad we went for it all. The time of both the year and day gave us the good fortune of having a very small group so we were able to have legitimate discussions. I cannot speak for what the experience may be like for a full group of 20 people, however based on ours, this is a tour experience that should not be missed.

During busy season, it is difficult to see any of the major sites in Rome without an organized tour. Most of these tours are chaotic, overcrowded, noisy, and rushed. This tour was well organized, and a reasonable size. The communication units worked well, and had good range. The guide was knowledgeable and considerate about allowing time to take pictures. This tour is about as good as it gets unless you can afford a personal private tour. Recommended.

Our tour guide Katalina, was just
amazing! She was not just
knowledgeable but so enthusiastic
about the ruins and history behind
it. She didn't just talk to the adults
but actively engaged our kids in the
history discussion as well. It was
terribly hot but she made sure to
find us shade and take a good
pace. I highly recommend the tour
and Katalina!

A huge thank you must go to Elena our guide on this amazing tour. She was absolutely fantastic, so knowledgeable and we were hooked on her every word. I’d definitely recommend this tour as it was well organised from the start and to have someone guide us around and give us so much information really made it for us. Thank you so much

The tour was absolutely amazing! Giovanni D’Anna was our guide. He was phenomenal! His passion for the history of the colosseum, the surrounding areas and the city of Roma in general came through in every story, anecdote or fact he shared with us. The way he described each event made me feel as if I were actually there during that time.
From Italy I traveled to Spain. After 1 week and several different tours I can say that Giovanni is hands down the best guide! A true master of his craft. We also had a great group. Thank you Giovanni for making my first trip to Roma unforgettable!!!

Sara gave an amazing tour to us. She is a historian with deep knowledge, at the same time she is so fun and passionate, making our entire tour engaging and entertaining. Her passion towards protection of Roman history radiates throughout her story telling. It is a very unexpected but satisfying experience! The tour exceeds our expectations.

Our guided tour of the Colosseum was a highlight of our trip to Rome. Understanding the history of Palatine Hill and the Forum was an unexpected bonus to experiencing the overwhelmingness of the Colosseum. Marcello V brought old ruins to life with his engaging stories and historical perspective.

This tour was a great way to see 3 of the top historic attractions in Rome. We did the 10:10 AM tour (booked via GetYourGuide) in September. It was a hot day and a lot of walking but most of it is manageable. There are a lot of people at the Colosseum and the tour provides quick access in and out of the Colosseum.

Our guide Guido was very friendly and had a lot of knowledge and information regarding the site and the history in general. He shared all this and more during the tour.

My favorite part of the tour is the Underground area of the Colosseum which is only accessible via a tour. There is enough time to take some picture inside and outside of the sites but it could feel a bit go-go at times.

We were given Whispers (radio devices) so listening to the tour guide is not a problem even with crowds. Take your own dual ear headphones if you like as the one that they provide is only for 1 ear. Sometimes there is static when you are away from the tour guide but it's not too bad.

Our first full day in Rome, we'd booked this tour of the Colosseum. All I can say is that it far surpassed our expectations. This was for two reasons: 1) The Colosseum itself, and 2) our tour guide, Lia Caso. Not only is Lia knowledgeable about the Colosseum on all fronts - from its history to its design - but she was absolutely able to make the experience come alive for us. From immersing us in the frame of mind of the gladiators, spectators and prisoners, to illustrating the daily operation of this historic structure, we couldn't have asked for a better experience. Thanks, Lia; you're the best!

Overall experience was excellent. Our guide Pelin was very informative and encouraged questions. If questions were asked she would repeat them so the whole group could understand the answer she gave. The organisation was superb and the communication system enhanced the tour.
We had the underground tour of the Colosseum which gave a very interesting insight to the running of the Roman games.

Had done the tour of Colosseum underground, Arena and Forum. Througly enjoyed the experience and learnt quite a bit about roman architecture, their emperors and the history behind this great landmark.

Giovanni was quite informative, patient and conscious of what we wanted. He gave us so much cool informantion and stories for us to remember and took the time to stop and explain every detail as he could. Quite exceptional work ethic and experience.

Thank you

Gabriele was our tour guide, and wow, 3 hours of nonstop facts, jokes and tidbits you'd be hard pressed to (easily) find without reading for hours. It was an absolute pleasure to be able to learn from him over the duration of the tour. We had a 9:00AM tour, so it wasn't too bad, but I could imagine a 12PM tour being brutal. I would recommend Gabriele as a tour guide for anything- his passion for the history and sites shines through the tour. Definitely a great experience!

Wow, just wow. Amazing job our guide did making a "once in a lifetime experience" ACTUALLY once in a lifetime. Great stories intertwined with the history right in front of us, happy to answer questions while keeping things moving.

Great work and thank you for making a day I've looked forward to for 20 years live up to those Expectations!

For the price we paid for the tour it alone was poor yes it was a small party only 16 but I gained more knowledge by reading the plaques on the route
The guide seemed to be following a script that if you asked difficult questions was palmed off with generalisations, and when you pointed out inaccuracies this was ignored completely at this point I turned the radio off because I said earlier I gained more in-site by reading the information that was all over the site. The safety of the tour should also be put into question as the temp was 37c it was hot especially when we were on the sands with no shelter. This made the tour rushed as we couldn't stay in any one place due to the heat
As for the underground part of the collesuem tour was hoping that we would have a guide from the collesuem but no we still had the same guide who really was just going through the motions. We had a very good your the day before at the Vatican museum and the guide gave us really good background information pity that this experience of time was overshadowed by this poor your

Wow, what a brilliant tour. Well organised and easy to find the meeting point. Guide was very knowledgeable and the headsets made it very easy to hear. We let the organiser know we were there and then went to a cafe ( meeting point was downstairs of the colosseo metro but their are two cafes at the top we preferred the one on the far right as there was no charge to use the toilet after breakfast) the tour guide answered all questions, nothing too much trouble. We had little knowledge before going but certainly learnt a lot. There are no refreshment stops but we had bottled water and there were water fountains dotted around to top up the bottles. Use wear comfy shoes as there is a lot of walking, stairs and standing. However a lift has been installed appt one point for those who needed it. By far our favourite location and tour. Worth the cost.

Phenomenal tour! Giovanni was knowledgeable and willing to answer questions. We learned so much, and our three young kids (ages 11, 9, and 6) were fully entertained. We are still talking about the wealth of new facts we acquired and the incredible experience we had. Seeing these historical and meaningful sites would not have been the same without this tour, at least for our family. It was worth it to spring for the smaller group size and underground/arena access at the Colosseum. As a homeschooling family on holiday in Rome, this totally counted as our "lesson" for the day!

Fernando was an amazing guide. We booked a semi-private tour and there were only 3 couples total. Because the group size was small we got to ask a lot of questions. Fernando was very knowledgeable and extremely passionate about his city. We really appreciated his insights, especially the additional research he provided when there was incomplete historical knowledge about use of rooms in the palace and Colosseum. I would highly recommend this tour and if you can spend a little extra, go for the semi-private tour with Fernando!!

Giovanni was well educated and very enthusiastic, not only about the history of the Colosseum, but of the history of Rome and it’s transitions over time.

Considering today’s gorgeous weather, everyone seemed to taking advantage and it was quite busy, yet Giovanni kept our group moving through the Underground and Arena at a comfortable pace. Never did we feel rushed, he took time to answer all questions from the group, and provided some fantastic insight.

We would highly recommend him to family, friends, and strangers alike if they asked about a special tour experience at the Colosseum.

Our only regret is that we didn’t sign up for the full tour that he hosted today which included the Forum, our bad there.

Next time, for sure!!! Grazie grazie grazie Giovanni! Arrivederci

My day started off on a rocky start so when I arrived to the Colosseum tour I was a bit irritated and flustered. However, my day quickly turned around when I met my guide for the day, Catalina. She definitely turned my frown upside down haha and I can’t recommend her tour enough. She was so informative but didn’t come off like a robot who was regurgitating information from a text book — she was essentially the best story teller and teacher. I loved every moment of my experience with her. This was the best part of my trip to Rome hands down. If you are also seeing this Catalina, thank you again and if you could maybe get my info from the company so you can send me those pictures that would be amazing!! Thank you again!!!!

Excellent knowledgeable Guide Daniele V. There is walking and stairs but the pace was accommodating. Guide knew how to navigate the group for the best experience. Suggestion to go early in the morning as the tour is 3 hours and the crowds come.

This was an outstanding small group tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Forum. Our guide Fulvia was among the best we’ve had in many years of European tours. Her English fluency and relaxed and informative narrative was a great experience for all of us. Administered by the Touriks organization, this experience was well managed, organized and delivered. Couple that with a great guide like Fulvia and the whole program was top-notch. Highly recommended. Good job Touriks; thank you so very much Fulvia!

Fantastic tour with Mario (I think that was his name) as our guide, very knowledgeable and brought the tour to life, the Colosseum was incredible especially the underground section which can only be visited through a tour, and was worth every penny!! After the tour was finished, we were free to wander around the Colosseum to explore more. I couldn’t use the headphones as I’m deaf, however I was able to stand next to Mario and understand what was being explained. Thank you very much for the experience!! Would definitely recommend.

My wife and myself had the most fantastic 3 hours. Our guide Katerina was so friendly and so informative it really made the experience so much more special. I would have no hesitation on recommending Touriks tours to family and friends absolutely fantastic from start to finish.

I took this tour yesterday whilst visiting Rome alone, I cant recommend enough.

Our tour guide Manola was amazing, so informative and passionate about the history of the colosseum, and the underground tour is definitely worth the extra you pay for it.

I just don't think you'd get the same experience without booking a guided tour. Manola even managed to get some lovely shots at the top of palatine hill for me, I'm so thankful as often not in many of my own pictures when travelling solo. In short I loved it!

Absolutely fantastic tour, leah the tourguide was so knowledgeable and amazing at conveying the stories and history, myself and my son thoroughly enjoyed the 3 hours and agree it was the highlight of our trip. We didn’t have to queue anywhere it was run smoothly.
Would definitely recommend this tour. This company are lucky to have such a fantastic guide!!

Our guide, Super Mario, was very calm and cool considering the heat of the day. He kept all of us flowing and great commentary infusing it with humour which kept us all interested. It was awesome seeing what happened under the floor of the colosseum.

Jade, the tour guide was amazing. Great knowledge and very friendly. Having a small group enabled us to see more and we were able to bypass the larger groups. The Colosseum Underground was received opened to the public and I would highlight recommend.

This small group tour was worth every penny. Our guide, Giovanni was excited to tell the story of Ancient Rome with the Colosseum and Roman Forum as his classroom. He was receptive to all of our questions and provided thoughtful responses and deep commentary. Giovanni taught from a depth of knowledge only gained by purposeful, formal study. He shares what is obviously his passion for his home and its significance to western civilization. If you appreciate those things, you will really appreciate this tour! Giovanni is a gem of a person.

Simply seeing the Colosseum and the Forum was spectacular, but our experience was enhanced by our tour guide Rosie! Rosie was engaging and incredibly knowledgeable. She was able to answer all of our questions, had us laughing and learning at the same time. The 3 hour tour seem to go by so fast because Rosie kept everyone engaged. She was delightful to listen to with the many different stories she knew about each area. She was able to describe how the ruins/buildings looked, and then showed us the pictures.

What a great experience. This was my last day of a three week European vacation, but easily my favorite day of the trip. Everything ran smoothly and on time. Our tour guide was Daniele V. To say he was fantastic is an understatement. Despite the huge crowds, Daniele V led us through the chaos, or as he calls it "Roman traffic," and made the tour a very personal experience. His commentary was informative, enlightening and very humorous. He had so many neat stories and facts and was so engaging. Highly recommend Touriks and Daniele V!

Myself and my daughter took a small group tour guided by Lia last Friday. The fact it was a small tgroup tour made it easier for us all to interact and ask questions. Lia was both interested in what she was doing and interesting in the way she told the stories. She was quite animated and made me smile many times with the way she told the stories of the history. I'd happy do the tour again the next time I visit in a few years time maybe.

Great tour, recommend pre-booking before you leave home.
19 of us had to wait 40 minutes for a couple that got lost which was a bit annoying, but the guide was very knowledgeable and clear. Amazing tour of the collaseum, the Palentine section became less about history and more the guide giving us a Christianity/religious lecture, which I personally found a bit dull and made the end of the tour drag a bit.

We went on our group tour with Inga on May 23rd and we loved it. She was a really engaging tour guide. We really enjoyed the humour she brought to her tour. The Roman Forum was incredible and would highly recommend anyone who would like to see it to take this tour as without a guide who knows the history the magnitude of this place could be missed. The colosseum was amazing to see, especially underground. Would highly recommend this tour with this company. Thanks Inga!

This was a wonderful tour and Sarah T was a very good tour guide. She was very knowledgeable and informative. I highly recommend this tour, as I prefer small groups that allow you to ask more questions and interact more with the guide. Sarah T was wonderful and I was very pleased with the entire experience.

Absolutely fantastic tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Roman Forum. Our guide (I can’t remember her name, a younger woman originally born in Romania, that has lived in Italy for 25 year), spoke perfect English (I was shocked that she wasn’t from an English speaking country), had an amazing knowledge of Rome, the Roman Empire, and their history. The history was presented in a short but sweet manner without a single moment of boredom throughout the entire 3 hour tour. It was a warmer day (84°F) and we didn’t even notice it as she was great about getting the group out of the sun, and chatting in the coolest areas. Such an amazing and insightful tour.
Everything was simply perfect. We highly recommend this tour.

Tom (our Forum guide) absolutely made our day - hands down the single most enjoyable tour I've ever experienced. What a storyteller! Tom really brought the history of the forum to life, weaving in the story of Rome amongst the ruins with just the right amount of information and humour. I had goosebumps with how he brought certain poetic imagery full circle at the end. He was considerate and helpful, finding us spots to sit comfortably in shade as he animatedly explained the sights. You can tell he has a true passion for history and for what he does.
Our colosseum tour was also mind-blowing - we are so glad we booked the underground and high level special access areas. Just fascinating and views were astounding. Our guide was absolutely lovely and a very knowledgeable archaeologist.
Could not have been happier with this tour, highly recommend ditching the audioguide and spending a little extra on an amazing experience.

It was an awesome tour ! I enjoyed the small group, we were able to cover a lot of different things quickly. I would highly recommend the underground part of the colosseum tour, well worth the extra money. Our tour guide Mario was very knowledgeable and made the tour fun with his humor.

We had a small English tour (6people) with an Italian tour guide RAF. She was incredible!!! She brought everything to life, could answer all our difficult questions and kept it so interesting that even our 17 & 21 year old kids could enjoy it. Wow! Bravo!
Additionally she managed to shorten all the queues with her charm and expertise. Definitely ask for her!

Our guide, Chiara (hope I spelled right), from Touriks, was fantastic. She was very knowledgeable and kept the tour moving (which the kids appreciated). The underground portion was very cool and well worth the extra cost.

The Touriks staff was very helpful with scheduling our large group of 19 into 2 smaller groups at the time we needed. The other group also had a great experience with their guide. Thank you Touriks!

We both loved this tour. The tour company was where they said they would be and holding the sign they said they would be (that has not been our experience with other companies). Have to admit, it is a special feeling walking past all the lines and being escorted pasted security ropes to get to the Underground. Maria was our guide and if you get her you are very lucky. Her English, knowledgeable, and humor are great. This tour was worth every penny.

Really enjoyed this tour of the colosseum, Roman forum and Palatine hill. Fulvia our guide explained everything very well, often using a book to illustrate what difference buildings looked like in the past vs. today. Being able to see the underground of the colosseum was also really interesting. I really recommend this tour.

Serena was very knowledgeable and helpful. She did a great job making sure to speak up for me, since I am cochlear implanted and could not wear the listening devices provided. I did not feel like I missed a thing, unlike other tours I have been on. Serena cared a great deal.

Incredible experience touring the colosseum with Inga (our tour guide), she was so informative and brought the experience to life. We had a small group of four of us which made it very personable and enjoyable. Would highly recommend this tour!

If everyone had as much pride in their work as Fernando, the world would be in much better shape. Could not have enjoyed our tour more, due entirely to him and his vast knowledge of the Colosseum and Forum. The three-hours flew by thanks to his passion for history and extraordinary storytelling. Make sure you request him by name!

Great experience. Sarah was very knowledgeable, kept us moving and tried to keep us in the shade. She covered so much info in the time we had. We listened to her over a headset so we could hear even if she was far away. I really liked being underground it helped my family understand the layout better when above ground. I appreciated her willingness to take photos for families. I would probably not recommend this tour for families with young children. The information was very dense. It was organized and I felt well taken care of.

Signed in easily at the meeting point and were met by our guide, can't remember her name but she was South African. Felt slightly sorry for her to be honest as we had 8 Americans with us who chatted to each other all the way round and at times it seemed she was talking to herself. Slight issue as we entered the Coliseum as one of them thought it was fine to take a pen knife and alcohol with him on the tour!!!
The tour itself was amazing and one I recommend but the amount of information you are given does blow your mind but we are talking about 1000s of years of history here so understandable. There's plenty of walking so go prepared.
If you only intend going once then this is definitely the tour for you.

Wow, what a tour!! So much to see and so much to hear about. Zenda was our guide and was very friendly and organised. She made sure we were all through security points together and made sure we all saw and understood the information she was giving us.

Very informative, there was so much to see in the forum and could’ve stayed hours but she showed us the most interesting parts as we also had the colosseum to see. What a mind blowing place. Going to the underground levels is a must, really interesting to see what happened and gives you a chance to stand on the level where the action took place - amazing!

Would definitely recommend doing this tour. Very well organised and friendly. Thanks for the tour!

Easy to book 3 of us on to the tour. First time for all going inside the Colossium. We were expecting a large group but there was actually only 5 if us. Instructions for meeting our guide were simple and the representatives were easy to find. Our guide Sam was friendly, had excellent English and provided us with a thoroughly enjoyable tour. He had a lot of knowledge and really gave an insight in to what it would have been like when it was in use. Our ticket included going round the forum and he asked if we wanted to stop the tour as the Forum was closing and the reconvene afterwards. Would definitely use them again and recommend to others. We evem got a 10% discount on our tickets for the Vatican a couple of days later.

You can totally rely on the reviews for this tour. We were in Rome for 3 days and this was by far the highlight. By the end of the tour your feet will hurt from all the walking, your jaw will ache from all the jaw dropping sights and your sides will ache from all the laughing you will do if you get Lia as your guide. This tour is exactly as described and is 100% worth every single penny.

We took this tour in Spanish, as we are Cubans living in Miami, we had such a great time with our guides.
The tour was very well organized and the guides very knowledgeable, we have a young lady from Spain (Did not take her name, she wears glasses) who took care of us inside the Colosseum, she explained about history, construction of the Flavian Amphitheater with many structural details, took us to the upper level (belvedere) through a locked door which make us feel "special guests" also we were at the underground tunnels which is fascinating.
On the afternoon we went to the Forum with Yamile which was extraordinary!! She is a Rome passionate who transmit her enthusiasm to the group.
The walk through the Forum ruins is an special time.
We love that the group was only about 10 people so the whole experience is more intimate.
Great tour, great time.
Very Thanks to the organizers and the tour guides.
The Cubans...

Daniele V (the 5th 😉) was the best tour guide! He was knowledgeable, funny, and very accommodating to the whole group. This was my favorite part of the trip to rome and Daniele made it that much better. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested in seeing the colosseum and other historical sites included.

Absolutely loved this small group tour (4 couples) to visit the Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill. Our guide, Gabriel, met us by the train station & we first visited the Roman Forum before exploring the underground of the Colosseum. Soooo incredible & Gabriel was absolutely wonderful! He was so knowledgeable & his english was perfect, and his little humor was so appreciated. This was the highlight of our visit to Roma!

Well if there was an option for 10 I would give it. Absolutely exceptional from start to finish. Would 100% recommend to anyone looking to book. Our guide Catalina (I apologise if I spelt this wrong) was amazing, her passion showed through the whole tour and nothing was too much to ask. As an added lovely gesture Touriks even bought my mum a cake for her special 60th Birthday! We both absolutely loved it and would recommend to anyone! Book! Book! Book!

I took the guided 3 hour tour of the Roman Forum and Colosseum with my wife and mother-in-law. The tour through both places was very informative. Our guide Serena was knowledgeable and entertaining. In addition to her commentary she showed us how the Forum and Colosseum looked in anciebt times using illustrations in a book and via iPad. She really helped to bring these historic places to life.

We were really excited for this tour as it is a major attraction when in Rome so i wanted it to be perfect. We felt we had picked a more expensive tour in the hope it would be amazing and blow us away. Unfortunately, we were disappointed. Our tour time was changed the day before due to over crowding in the colosseum. So we arrived at the new time as requested, not a massive issue. Our tour guide was knowledgeable no doubt, however we found it very difficult to understand her and found her lacking in enthusiasm. It was a real shame.

Excellent experience. Only 8 people in our group which was great for the kids. Our guide was really aware of how hot it was, moving us through the crowds, finding shade for the kids and keeping them engaged for the full three hours. Could not recommend more highly……our guide was Ahmed.

Our guide had lots of Roman colosseum info. The first level is a must see since it was built layer on layer. We did leave the tour before the end due to it being a miserably hot day. The Roman created elevators, stage theatrics, seating charts, water ways. Very barbarically interesting. I was with my daughter

We had an amazing day with Serena touring the Colosseum, the Forum, and Palatine Hill. I have been on many, many tours of historical sites, and Serena was the most knowledge and personable guide I have toured with. The price was very reasonable, we skipped all of the lines at entry, and got to see parts of the Colosseum that are not on the regular entry ticket. Highly recommend!!

Booked the tour c/o Trip Advisor, via Touriks. Hassle free meet up and simple instructions. We had the pleasure of Fabio for the afternoon. Amazing knowledge and stories about the Colosseum and surrounding areas. The underground and floor level tour are inspiring and give greater understanding of how the place worked. We then continued to Forum and Palatine Hill. Fabio was highly entertaining and could answer all questions thrown at him easily.

A recommended tour, and an added bonus of the fabulous Fabio. Many thanks.

We had a tour guide named Manola who was extremely friendly and engaging. She really knew her stuff and was always happy to answer questions. Her English was excellent and very easy to understand. The tour was good value compared with other tour guides, especially given the fact that you get access to both the underground and the arena. Would highly recommend if looking for a tour.

I absolutely recommend this tour and if you can get Marle as a tour guide you will not be disappointed. Marly was extremely knowledgeable and her passion for the history of the colosseum and forum made the tour so enjoyable. The experience was seamless from beginning to end. I 100% recommend.

Pelin was our guide and she was great. The your company provides an earbud and a device so you can hear the guide properly, as we had a relatively large group. I liked that we started the tour with the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, as the Colosseum would be less busy later in the afternoon. The underground is not to be missed - it truly provides a different perspective. Palin cannot be faulted, I just felt it was a bit rushed in the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. There were so many things to see in those 2 locations, although I understand the Colosseum is the highlight for most people.

Damiano was a great guide, best guide we had on our entire trip.
He was very knowledgeable and explained everything very well.
I also really appreciated Damiano finding all the shaded areas to cool us off on this extremely hot day.

Laura was our guide and took us through the Colosseum and The Forum. She was very knowledgeable on all of the areas and stories around both of those places, and gave us great anecdotes and kept the descriptions concise but enough to give us a really great feel for everything. We were able to see the underground of the Colosseum which just opened a month earlier, but she was well informed on everything that we were seeing.

Overall, an amazing experience that I would recommend for anyone!

Our guide Pelin was incredible. She was very patient and answered everyone's questions with an incredible amount of knowledge. She corrected misconceptions and provided an abundance of information that is uncommon to outsiders. It was very hot out when we went and she found places of shade for us to explain things and led us to multiple fountains to stay hydrated. I can't thank her enough for the experience.

A great history lesson with unforgettable views. Daniele V was easy going and knowledgeable. Our group of 8 learned so much from him and he was patient and kind. I highly recommend taking the tour as you get to skip lines, don't have to worry about admission fees, and get great insight into what occurred centuries ago. Thank you Daniele V for making the day entertaining!!

Although we were really looking forward to this tour, it fell short for us for two reasons. First, was not the fault of our guide. To get into the Colosseum, two tours had to go in at once, while our guide made sure we were there, the other one was late. So we were not able to use the restroom before we started the the inside part of the tour. Second, we were hoping for more time in the actual Colosseum. At times it felt we were biting our time waiting to get in.

Thank you. We had such a good tour with Elena. There was only four of us in the group. Elena got us through without queuing, she was funny and had a great depth of knowledge and spoke very good English. I recommend her and the tour, and going as early in the day as possible.

This is my second tour of Rome and I promised I had to come back and take a tour of the underground of the Coliseum. No regrets, none at all. This is why travelers dream of destinations and making journeys happen. This tour is a wonderful learning experience rich with history of Rome from 3000 years ago. Our tour guides were knowledgeable, engaging and planned the tour efficiently and thoroughly. I must say they were exceptionally professional and provided so much informative feedback. Overall this tour is highly recommended. The only negative was, we were confused when the tour was actually over, since we were blended with another tour group and were not
formally dismissed as to when the sessions were definitively ended. We all were lost in finding the exits in that massive Coliseum. Nevertheless, after inquiries made to 3 different ticket agents, we were able to
make our exits.

We loved this tour as it brought to life all the images we had in our heads of the actual scale and ingenuity of the buildings the Romans had constructed. Our tour guide, Fabiana was so engaging and was full of factual information that it really did add to the awe of the Colosseum. Our guide also took us through the history of how the Romans had established themselves through the archeology that was on show from Palatine Hill and the Roman Forum. Loved this tour and Cant wait to watch the film Gladiator again. Only downside was that the tour finished at 6:00pm just as the cafe closed, but wasn't a big problem as plenty of cafes and restaurants on was back to hotel!

Elena was an amazing guide who really brought the tour to life. Very informative and friendly. Highly recommend the underground tour as the other tours don't allow you to see the real working of the Colosseum. Highly recommend hat and water if doing this tour during the day!

Three hour tour was was worth the money and time. Serena was so informative and gave us detailed insight to what otherwise just looks like ruins. She created images in my mind that brought these ancient times back to life. This semi private tour has made this experience one of the best so far.

This was an amazing tour! We had a group of 12, not too big. Tony was our tour guide and he was extremely knowledgeable and energetic. The detailing, architecture and history was phenomenal. The Sistine chapel was mesmerizing and my jaw dropped when I walked into St Peters Basilica. Next time I’m in Rome I would book this again!

We had a great tour of the colosseum, couldn’t have been any better! Our tour was with Sarah, she was so lovely and definitely made sure she went into detail. We often lost track of time as other small groups were way in front, so we had an in-depth tour. We also got tickets to the Roman forum and palatine hill which you could visit in your own time and pace. This is definitely the tour to go for. We spent a full day there 10am-15:30/16:00. Thanks again Sarah :)

Serena did an excellent job sharing not only the historical significance of the colosseum, but helped us imagine what things were like 2,000 years ago and the impact the politics and power played in Roman life. Serena was a great story teller and made the 3 hours go by extremely quickly. I highly recommend this tour with Serena!

Superb! Thank you Marle for an amazing tour of the Palatine Hill, the Forum and the incredible Colosseum. We were blown away by everything we saw and learned, and would highly recommend this small group tour to everyone. We cannot think of a better way to see these incredible sights, and loved our morning with such an interesting guide - mille grazie!!

To be clear about this tour, this company doesn’t offer the tours, they just hand you off to tour guides at the Colosseum and the Roman forum, so I don’t know how much control they have over the tour guides. The guide at the Colosseum was pretty poor to average. We did get to see everything, top levels, main level, stage, underground, but the commentary was just poor. She also wouldn’t permit photos while she was commentating which I understand, but made the tour rough since the commentary put us to sleep, very rote.

The Roman forum guide, Tom, was the opposite. Absolute cream of the crop as far as tour guides go. Done many many tours around the world and he really stands out, combining passionate and educational presentation, enlightening commentary, well timed quips, and incredibly organized structure. My traveling companion swears he also works as an educator. I could have listened to him all day, made the Roman forum, admittedly not something I was super excited to see, come alive and be a memorable portion of my trip. Tip my hat to him

This was my first time going to Rome and being able to experience the Colosseum. My family and I were blessed with the guidance of Lia. Her enthusiasm made the visit so much fun. Along with her radiating energy, she assisted us with setting ourselves up with heading toward our next tour with much ease. I would recommend anyone to go and see the Colosseum, but I would highly recommend they have a guide as amazing as Lia.

Fantastic excursion going underground where the gladiators would have been and animals. We were part of an 8 people excursion that made all the difference when the guide was explaining everything made it very personal. Would recommend highly and it was a great time in on plaitine hill and the Roman forum. Was well worth the trip and if you get the chance to visit don’t miss it.

Excellent tour. Meeting point was easy to find and staff very helpful in helping sort out our vaccinations certs (non EU green pass) and made sure we got in.
Radios with fresh headphones are a boon to not have to strain to the front all the time.
Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, informative and took us at a nice steady pace sharing many stories and archaeological tidbits.
Tour itself in the underground and arena of colesseum is a real education and worth this particular tour. Highly recommended tour company.

The Tour Left without us !!! Our tour was scheduled to "depart" at 1:35 pm. We had an earlier tour elsewhere and rushed to make this tour on time. Having never been to the Colosseum, which is huge, we had to find the green meeting booth. We arrived at the Colosseum at about 1:15 pm, and found the green booth by 1:25. We were told by other guides there that our tour was always by the tree and that the guide had a yellow flag. We looked and looked but no one with a flag was there at 1:30 pm. We thought 1:35 pm actually meant 1:35 pm ! The tour clearly left by 1:30 pm as we were in the exact spot no later than 1:28 to 1:30. We called the tour for 9 minutes and no one answered. when they finally answered they told us that even though the scheduled departure was 1:35, and even though the tour clearly left before 1:30, it was our fault for not being there 30 minutes before. So I guess a departure time of 1:35 is not really 1:35 and unless you get there 30 minutes before you are not entitled to take the tour that you paid for. Of course there were no other tours and no tickets available so on our only day in Rome, we couldn't get inside the Colosseum, which was heartbreaking and upsetting. I wouldn't take a tour which is not reliable and when the tour departs before the scheduled 'departure' time, its not reliable. I can't say how good the tour was because they left without us but my advice is to take a tour which accurately holds to their 'departure' time.

We had a wonderful small group tour this morning. We did the whole tour of the Colosseum and the Forum. Valerie was super informative, patient, and upbeat despite the heat. We can even had people who weren’t in our tour group try to tag along because they could hear her presentations. She answered our questions and our teenage daughters had a great time. Highly recommend. The small group was nice. It was easier to maneuver through the crowds and engage with our guide.

This tour couldn’t have been any better. Lia Caso was INCREDIBLE as a tour guide. The trip started with very clear directions of where to meet. Everyone there who was in charge of getting us situated was kind and organized. Once the tour began I knew it was going to be an amazing time. Lia is incredibly sweet and caring and personable. Her passion for the city is evident immediately. She is energetic and fun and I honestly never wanted the tour to end. There was never a dull moment and I learned so much on this tour and was blown away by Lia’s knowledge and excitement for the sites. She delivered the tour in a way in which I felt transported back to the time period. It was evident how much she loves the city and she passed that love on to all of her participants. She has an amazing spirit and if I could I would hire her to be the tour guide on every vacation I ever took. I don’t think I will ever have a tour guide as perfect as Lia. She made the tour a million times better than I could have imagined.

Wonderful tour! Inga, our guide, was exceptional from start to finish. She was very well versed with the sites history, informative, caring of the groups comfort level, and had a good sense of humor. It was a special treat to have Inga, who was able to answer engineering questions about the collesium; she had an understanding of the different systems inside the collesium from the seismic build to the lighting, and the water. We were able to see everything as advertised, the underground tour was quick but totally worth it. The Collesium was magnificent; spoiler, cannot believe it was built in 8 years. If you are an architect or engineer I would recommend asking for Inga specifically.

Well I would leave a slightly lower review but the tour guide I had was very fun and made it interesting. I could of read the tour wrong but I did not get to see anything underground. The tour of Paltine hill and forum was amazing and I highly recommend that. The colosseum was just a ticket to go in and no tour of that but it did work out ! I totally could of read it wrong so I can’t hold that against them! The others in my group walked right in but I had to wait 40 minutes to go in to colosseum which was strange. Other than that yeah I would recommend it because of how great the tour guide was she was awesome!

Expensive, but nice to be in a small group. Rosy was a great guide, very knowledgeable and good at trying to give us the maximum space possible in a very crowded tourist location. Very worth including the underground tour of the Coliseum.

Our tour started 10 minutes late due to the guide not arriving on time. Overall it was very interesting and informative. Our guide was mediocre and seemed to be going through the motions. When the tour ended, she just said, the tour is over,give me your headsets. She just walked away and left us standing, somewhat dumbfounded.

It’s is an amazing historical site, rich in history.

Our guide’s lack of enthusiasm and disjointed presentation left us underwhelmed.

This was an excellent tour. Our guide, Elena, was fabulous--so knowledgeable but didn't overload us with information and didn't take herself too seriously. Her sense of humor and care for us (pointing out restrooms, shady/cool spots to rest, etc.) gave the tour a personal touch and helped us to really enjoy and take in all that we were seeing. Wonderful experience!

The colosseum tour was a must for me and my husband. We were impressed by our tour guide “Sara”. She is very informative. She knows the best spot for pictures and she was happy to take pictures for anyone. Sara is very caring, always asked if we needed bathroom or water break. The group is not too big, giving us the chance to ask questions and talk with the tour guide.

First of I never write one star reviews. We booked this tour with the hopes to have an excellent tour guide. Our tour guide was terrible - really didn't understand how to guide the group, kept droning on with almost zero context / it was extremely difficult to follow and almost had zero breaks. During the quarter mark, about and during the half way mark, almost everyone was zoning out and took off their headphones. About the half way point everyone zoned out. It was clear the tour guide either didn't have experience or Touriks just decided to hire some random person.

The best part of the tour honestly was when it ended - the sigh of relief from everyone was evident. I do not recommend.

Our tour guide Katarina was great and super knowledgeable as she has a masters in Italian history. Visiting the underground and arena floor is well worth the extra cost. Those areas are not accessible with normal general admissions. We are glad that we did the 9am tour as it got pretty hot later in the day. True to the advertisement, our group size was limited to a dozen people making the experience much more enjoyable.

100% highlight of our holiday to Rome and part I will remember always. We paid a little extra for a private tour and it was so worth it. Our guide Rosy was amazing, so knowledgeable, she explained The Colosseum in a series of stories that were easy to follow. I loved how our guide skipped all the queues and took us underneath the Colosseum- best part as it is very well preserved. Rosy interacted well with our teenagers and really engaged them, like a family friend! We had generated lots of questions about life in Rome and Rosy answered them all. The 3hr tour felt like 30mins. Also, Rosy had pictures of what the structures (Colosseum, Palace on Palatine hill and Roman Forum) would’ve looked like in their prime and this helped a lot! I think we slowed her down with all our questions but she was so patient and had to sprint to her next tour in the end! Can’t recommend this tour company enough! Tip: when locating the tour start point, go to entrance of the Metro station, there is a kiosk outside and Touriks lady is standing next to kiosk holding a yellow card. Took us a while to find her!

Probably the only option to experience thr best of ancient Rome. Palatine Hille, The Forum, then The Colosseum from the newly opened underground exhibit, making you way up the level as you finish at the top.

I highly recommend this tour. I hesitated with the price compare to the others, but do not let that deter your. I came away not feeling like one cent was wasted, it was money well spent.

Consider this tour! Our guide was very informative as well, even with some rain in Palatine Hill, she was very patient band thorough.

Lia is the best tour guide I have ever had!!!! She felt like family within minutes. She was so animated and lively and made every single second interesting and entertaining. She knew every nook and cranny and had amazing stories and visuals. She truly goes above and beyond for her work and my entire group loved her. She even had brilliant recommendations for further attractions and restaurants, that ended up being wonderful. We truly wanted to take her back with us to spend the rest of the day❤️ We even took such fun photos together to always have the memories.
The trip with Lia was worth every second and would honestly go again in a heartbeat!! Love you Lia <3

Excellent tour on Wednesday 25 May and value for money. Our tour guide Massimo was excellent and took his time to explain everything in detail and always found a quite corner or space for us to stop and take in the sights. Would recommend this tour.

20/10 recommend! This is the only Colosseum tour you should be doing - also seeing the Roman forum and Palatine Hill is so worth it. I had no idea how beautiful the view from the top of the hill would be. Seeing the underground part of the colosseum added so much to our tour. Most tours don’t have this part but it’s definitely worth it. Then we were able to get access to gated parts of the main levels that some other groups couldn’t, and so our views were unobstructed by large crowds. So so so worth it, can’t say it enough

So it is easy to get overwhelmed with all the things to see and history. Alice did a great job of keeping us moving at a comfortable place and helping us to appreciate the significance, barbarity, and changes over time. She also did a great job looking after our elderly parents.

Liya was an incredible guide. She was very engaging, imaginative, and warm. She provided a lot of details and answered all of our questions. She also accommodated a wide range of ages and energy levels. She even suggested restaurants in another city when she heard we were traveling there!

This tour was really good. We were a small group and the guide was incredibly knowledgeable. It is always nice to have a local running these!

The underground part was fascinating, I guess the only thing I would have liked more of is a bit more time down there, but this was not something the guide could control.

Note; I had already been on the gladiator guided tour earlier that day. I was a bit worried when booking that I would get the same information on both tours, however, I learnt so many things from each.

Our tour guide, Sara was fantastic. Great pace throughout the tour (not too fast, not too slow) good story teller and also very knowledgeable (she has degrees in history and art history). The visit of the colosseum's underground section is, by itself, worth the time. But the exploration of the Forum and the Palatine hill's ruins revealed the birth place of Rome in a fascinating way.

Absolutely phenomenal tour!! The underground part of the tour was fascinating, so don’t miss it, and the rest of the colosseum was amazing as well. Our guide Catalina was incredible! She had the timing down to a science while being willing to constantly answer everyone’s questions. Her knowledge of the area and overall history of Rome is remarkable.

I loved that in the middle of the tourism chaos, Michael was there with a smile and a wealth of information. Our guide, Pelin, was just as great. She addressed all our questions, was well versed on everything; therefore, I would highly recommend this tour to everyone --totally loved it!

Our guide, Fernando (Fernandino) was great; funny, very knowledgeable and his English was excellent. Even our 12yr old enjoyed the tour around the Colosseum and the Imperial gardens. Highly recommend this trip and having a guided tour is so worth it as, otherwise, we wouldn't have understood and appreciated what we were seeing if we didn't have Fernando explaining stuff.

Solid tour but with hiccups. There was some communication about moving it back 20 minutes to prevent crowding in the colosseum, but it ended up starting about an hour after the original start time while waiting in 90 degree heat. More organized communication would have been appreciated. Aside from that, the underground experience was extremely cool and worth the extra money…you get to walk in the same tunnels as the gladiators and look up at the seats as they would have, thousands of years ago.

Lia Caso our tour guide was unbelievable! This is an experience of a lifetime. Do not pass it up. Lia shared stories that brought us back to when the Colosseum was bustling with Romans. My favorite part is she would say “this is a photograph of XX” when we visited a carving. What a beautiful way to think of our past and remember it. If you can request Lia - please do. This is her heritage, her story and she brings it to life.

Serena did an amazing job explaining the Colosseum, the Colosseum underground, and the Roman Forum. I have been on at least two other Colosseum guided tours as well as a tour of the underground and forum, but Serena made this my best experience to date at each venue.
