She took us to an amazing look-out area where we had incredible views of the Forum and much of Rome. Serena provided detailed information and put that information into context of life at the time. Her description of the lives of the Vestal Virgins was particularly interesting. She highlighted how Rome is layer upon layer of different time periods, and her term of an archeological lasagna was apt. It was particularly interesting to hear how far various marble pieces had been brought and then how they were recycled into other works after the fall of Ancient Rome. I would certainly book another tour with Serena if the chance arose!

Elena, who is also an archaeologist, led our small group of 9 people through a 3 hour journey of fun, interesting and enlightening information on the history and facts of the Roman Empire and ruins there of. We skipped all the queues and were able to avoid being lost in the masses of tourists. It was a genuinely fantastic tour and one of the best I’ve done worldwide. I’d highly recommend this. You won’t be disappointed.

Great tour but if you aren't a huge walker or have mobility issues this will be a challenge! We first got to the Colosseum and it was stunning but after 2 hours of a tour of the underground and upper level we couldn't walk any further. There is an elevator at this location but with the extreme heat and lack of seating we had to step away early. Our tour guide was lovely and informative. We were super disappointed we couldn't continue on to the major sites but are happy we got to see the greatest one! My best advice: book this tour if you can walk for hours to the different attractions.

This tour was great and worth every penny, I can't remember our guide's name( I feel bad about that) but she was great! The tour was exactly as described and finding the location was incredibly easy the directions were spot on. It was a rare treat to take this tour. There were no issues with tickets or entry. Our guide took the time to explain everything to us and answer all the questions. When I plan a return visit to Rome this will be very high on my list of things to book first. The guide also had pictures for reference to help show us the scale of what we were looking at and put it into perspective. I recommend you book this tour if you are visiting Rome

This was an absolutely brilliant tour. We only had 8 in our group and our guide was so knowledgeable and helpful. It was really hot, so he took time out for rests and water refills, and to seek shade when possible. We got to skip all the queues and also visit the underground areas of the Colosseum as well as the main arena. Then after a rest we were taken up Palatine Hill to see the Forum from above. Took about 3 hours in total with rest stops. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. It’s not cheap for a family of 4, but it was worth every penny!

Having seen Rome so many times and had plenty of guides, Fernando was simply brilliant start to finish. His style is flowing and interesting. The topics were meaningful and relevant. Clearly explained and enthusiastically conveyed in a way that was engaging and fresh. Always took the time to answer questions concisely and he had a natural gift for explaining factual stories with a light hearted humour for what sometime cab be quite heavy topics. We will be back. Austin and Alana

Claudia, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and explained the history of the locations with vivid detail and in an entertaining way. She was also very considerate of our time and needs as we walked through the heat of the day. Overall, it was a very good experience and highly recommend it.

Our favorite tour during our trip to Rome. Very organized, meeting place was accurate. Radios and earbuds worked great with long range. Lots to see, underground access was worth it. Our guide was Mario and he was amazing. 100% recommend

We loved our tour of the Roman Forum, Palatine Hill and the Colosseum Underground with our excellent guide Gabriele, who was so engaging and clearly passionate about sharing his vast knowledge of Ancient Rome with us. It was our second visit to these sites and with Gabriele leading the way we had a far more memorable and meaningful experience. We would gladly tour with Touriks and Gabriele again!

Colosseum was busy and not having to wait in line was a major plus. I wouldn't even think about trying to do this on my own. The Colosseum is huge and having a tour guide is the best way to see the Colosseum. Donnatella took us underground and was able to deliver the highlights you want to hear. I don't know why you would go to the Colosseum and not do the Underground portion as it's where you can see where the gladiators and animals were housed and also all the underground engineering is in sight. Great Tour and would do again.

We had Marcello V. yesterday and had a great experience. On our tour we had two young girls and he was patient with us and our (sometimes) slow walkers. Marcello was personable and made our experience at the Colosseum, Arena and Forum much more enjoyable as he added color to the history. We would do this tour again.

Tour guide was early and easy to find right outside the train station. Guide (Samuela) was very knowledgeable, seemed genuinely intrigued by questions and responded to the limits of his knowledge, which was deep, without pretension, and also kept the tour moving. He was clearly passionate about history, the colosseum, and the future plans for the area as a cultural and historic site. The tour is a little long for kids (mine is 12) but it’s just-right for interested adults.

TLDR: The sites the tour covers are amazing—I’d just say gently that if you don’t want to pay attention then you’ll miss out on a lot and it may all look like old Roman/medieval stuff—but if you do follow along with the tour and the narrative you start to see the connections and echoes and cultures throughout the sites weaving together into a remarkable story that is still being told. Maybe that’s a bit much, but that was my experience. And our tour guide Sam was very good company.

We were out in Rome for several days exploring some of the sights the city has to offer. As a family we were all looking forward to this tour the most and i have to say we were not disappointed!
Faby our guide was absolutely amazing, extremely knowledgeable and informative but delivering in a way that was fun and engaging also.
The Colosseum is most definitely the highlight of the tour and being able to visit all areas, the underground, arena and upper levels is definitely the way to see it.
Would highly recommend this tour, and a massive thank you to Faby!

My husband and I took part in this tour today and we are very satisfied. Our guide Inger is very knowledgeable and she managed to present the facts and ”stories” in a good way. The tour lasted about 3 hours but time flew quickly when it was so interesting. I can really recommend you to take this tour with Inger.

LOVED this tour. Guide (Faby) was amazing - extremely knowledgeable and presented information in a clear and interesting way. Was worried about heat during summer months but there was plenty of shade along the route and we stayed comfortable the whole time. Small group size was perfect.

Francesca B was an amazing tour guide. She was extremely knowledgeable and you could tell she enjoys showing people around. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a tour guide in and around the Colosseum.

One of the main things I wanted to do in Rome was see the newly opened Colosseum Underground, and it was well worth it. Our group was smallish (about 12 people) and our guide was Manola. Her knowledge and friendly attitude made the tour even that much more enjoyable. She did not hurry us along, and spent time answering all of our questions. We also visited Palestine Hill and the Roman Forum and it was like “the icing on the cake”. To see all of this in around 3 hours and hear all about the history and little known facts of Rome was great.

We had our tour with Daniele and he was amazing! He was very informative and knowledgeable about the history and events surrounding the Forum and Colosseum. Daniele was high-spirited and it was easy to see that he was passionate about the subject. We highly enjoyed tour and highly recommend it!

Our guide for this extensive tour was wonderful. The more than 3 hour tour was packed with information and our guide answered every question our group asked. It is hard to imagine having had a better survey of Palatine hill, the Forum, and the Colosseum.

This was such a fun, thorough, and informative tour. I don’t consider myself a person who likes group tours but this tour was 100% the right choice for anyone visiting These sites, esp. for the first time. There’s no signage or explanations at the forum or the underground etc. so having a guide to really understand what you’re looking at and all the history behind it felt essential. I was really glad we had chosen this in particular he was so knowledgeable and fun. I thought it also moved at a great pace. I highly recommend this and honestly I’d do it again.

The best tour we were on during our Rome trip! Initially felt that the price was a little steep for a tour, but it was well worth the experience. Catalina, our tour guide, was so knowledgeable of both ancient and modern history, and was also very friendly and funny. Definitely book this tour if you are planning to visit the Colosseum!

Brilliant tour guide full of knowledge and fun facts. Really worth starting your tour at 9am as the queues are so much smaller.
Juliano really knew his stuff, thank you for a great few hours

We had been wanting to visit the Colosseum for many years and thanks to Sonia our guide this tour made it a very special experience. Being able to explore under the Colosseum floor, with newly opened areas was amazing and our favourite part. The palatine hill and Roman forum were so interesting with wonderful views and so much history. Sonia really brought it to life and allowed us to imagine what it would have been like. A great tour that made a great holiday!

The directions for meeting up were very accurate. We were met and greeted and all was in order. Our tour guide, we believe her name was Francesca, she had a small doll on her tour pole, was excellent. She provided clear and articulate information with enthusiasm. There is a lot of walking and stairs, which we knew in advance, so wear comfortable walking shoes for both even and uneven footing. The tour, with Francesca, was well worth the money.

Small group was perfect size. Our guide was knowledgeable, funny and really nice. She explained all the important things, stopped for us to take photos and took pics of us so we didn’t only have selfies. The underground tour is really cool, gives you the full perspective on the Colosseum, highly recommended!!

Well worth the extra money to have a guided tour, unlike the Vatican. The guide gives information that is very interesting that you probably not know doing a tour on your own. Very interesting too.
Do the tour in the morning, before it gets to hot. There is a fair climb up the hillside, obviously take fluids. Definitely not wheelchair/pushchair friendly

We had Faby as our tour guide, she was so knowledgeable, friendly and made the tour an overall fantastic one. the 3.5 hrs went really fast, and it wasn't like a boring history lesson. We stopped at cerin points to take pictures, and only had a small waiting time to skip the ques. Well worth it. I learned so much and my two teenagers enjoyed it too. There is a lot of walking involved so be aware there are lots of steps and uneven pathways.
It was also great only being in a small group, there were only 10 of us.
I would recommend this tour 100%. Thank you Faby for a fantastic day.

Incredible experience - we all learned so much from our tour guide Mario- he weaved in stories, humor and brought the history to life. There were many unexpected turns and sections. Bring water and comfortable shoes for this journey back in time to Lions, Gladiators and Royals.

Our tour with Serena was fantastic! We were amazed at how much we learned about Roman history, from the lasagne sheet layering to some of the mysteries about the colosseum. You could tell Serena was passionate about Rome.. she was so inspiring and really brought out our imagination and showed interesting photos as well. This experience was unforgettable for us. Definitely recommend this tour to anyone!

Our tour guide Samueli (Sam) was very informative and entertaining. He didn't rattle off facts but explained in detail how the Arena and Forum has evolved over the centuries. We had been to the Coliseum before but never toured the underground. It was really cool to see and we were awestruck by the antiquity surrounding us. Sam really had a great knowledge of the entire area and was very good at answering all our questions. He extended the tour by a few minutes to answer more questions which we really appreciated. We highly recommend this tour.

Had a great tour guide and learned so much. This tour took us to the Forum first which was fabulous as we avoided the hottest part of the day and the crowds that we saw as we headed to the Colosseum. Very knowledgeable guide.

We did a 3 hour tour with Daniele V - I have to say this was the absolute highlight of our time in Rome!!!! Daniele was so knowledgeable and engaging as a guide, he knew so many stories and clever details. My partner and I were blown away with the experience. It was my first time, and my partners 3rd time, but we both learnt so much about the colosseum and surrounds. We were very impressed and could not have asked for a more dedicated tour leader. Thank you Daniele V :-)

Catalina led us on an unforgettable tour of the Colosseum both below and above ground then the Palatine hill and Forum.She was full of information and energy and helped us to get the best out of our visit. Highly professional, friendly and engaging. Always enough information but never too much. Highly recommended.

This was the best tour we have ever had anywhere. The Colosseum is an amazing place, and the underground tour far surpassed our expectations. Our guide Giulia was extremely knowledgeable informative and truly passionate about every fact and detail about the entire area. The Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill area is not to be missed!! And the small group (6 people) enabled us to get a much greater appreciation and deeper understanding of every aspect. DO NOT miss this trip. ANd ask for Giulia.

I have a family of five, that includes three energetic boys aged 8 and 6 (twins). I was concerned about their ability to pay attention and to also not be a distraction for the other tourists. Our tour guide, Catalina, was great! Every time one of the boys asked something, it was always “that’s a great question,” followed by an informed and interesting answer. Catalina had endless patience, the Coliseum was awesome, the tour was fun, and we all had a good time. I definitely recommend it.

We booked this tour mainly to visit the the coliseum underground but the major part of the tour was the Palestine hill. We had Super Mario as our guide he was amusing informative and knowledgable. A very interesting tour so glad we picked this one we would have missed so much had we done this on our own.

We absolutely loved this tour. We are not tour people at all and would have rather have done this on our own. However, we really wanted to do the Underground part which is only accessible by tours. It absolutely blew us away. We are so glad we paid to do this as our guide Daniele was awesome. He was very knowledgeable and semi funny at times. There were kids of all ages in our group and he made a point to get them involved and move them up front so they could see better. To us, who normally explore everything on our own, were absolutely blown away. To see and understand how the Colosseum worked really got us into the history of it and the kids wanted to be more involved.

Our guide Fernando was well organised and a very knowledgable, entertaining and engaging guide. The tone and pace of the tour were perfect: we covered a lot of things but we never felt like we were being rushed to the next place and although Fernando obviously knows his subject very well, we never felt that we were bombarding with information. Everything was very well explained and accompanied by interesting and/or amusing details with added humour or pathos in the appropriate places.

An informative and interesting tour delivered by a very knowledgeable guide. Pelin our guide made the tour enjoyable and our children were encapsulated throughout the tour asking questions which our guide happily answered. Delivered at a good pace.

We had a fantastic tour with Inga, super informative and kept as all entertained with amazing backstories. In the baking heat in the peak of midday, Inga always helped to accommodate for everyone with regular breaks where needed, water refills and shade. Very personal tour and we genuinely forgot that this is a frequent tour as it felt so tailored to the group. Would 100% recommend this tour!

To walk on the same ground as centurions, gladiators, wild animals and thousands of slaves is a humbling experience. I am glad I went down to the basement of the Colosseum. Very much worth it if you’d like to imagine what it was like for them.
However, if it’s not really in your budget, a good YouTube video, plus a tour of the top portions would probably do too. But the tour!! Yes - definitely take a tour.

Great communication! Was called by company the day before to confirm. Unfortunately, the language of the tour was Italian but on Trip Advisor it was listed as English. All other tours were full so unable to reschedule. Dennis was very helpful getting us into the colosseum and with the Italian tour. Trip advisor needs to review their add to ensure the correct language can be selected on their order page. We did the tour anyway but unable to benefit from the guide.

The tour of the Roman Forum was perfect! Our guide, Rosy, spoke perfect english and was incredibly knowledgeable! Being an archeologist, she taught us so much more than the history alone. Very well done! Highly recommend this company!

Inga gave us an absolutely brilliant tour! She was friendly, knowledgeable, helpful, and was always finding shade for us when we were walking the Forum and Palentine Hill, as it was a very sunny, hot day. Tour continued on to the Colosseum, where she gave us the fascinating history of the Colosseum, Arena and Underground. Highly recommend this five-star tour!

This was a great tour as it included the Palatine hill which is a huge area with much history. Giovanni D'Anna was our guide and he was very likable and shared a great deal of knowledge. Small tours like this are worth the money.

The best tour-experience of my wonderful stay in Rome, all on account of my fantastic tourguide Donatella.

She's the best and nicest person: not only in terms of knowledge and her storytelling skills, but also in terms of openness and especially her humor. Such made my experience unparalleled.

Highly recommended!

Excellent tour. Highly recommend paying the extra money for the Underground portion of the tour. Our tour guide Lucia was great!! She spoke fluent English, was easy to understand , and was very knowledgeable. I highly recommend Explore Italy Tours.

Amazing tour having Donatella as our guide. She was extremely knowledgeable & led a most in-depth tour. Her passion for Rome & its history was clearly evident & reflected in her detailed & lively discussions. Also, her command of the English language made the experience so much more enjoyable compared to other guides we've had so far on our trip. Highly recommend Touriks & Donatella!

This was a wonderful tour. Our guide Francesca was a pleasure…very knowledgeable, fun and really made this a fantastic experience. This tour includes the Palatine Hill/palace. Please make sure you wear good walking shoes- we tracked over 17,000
Steps on this tour- lots of stairs, uneven terrain. The Colosseum does have elevators, however, you definitely need to be able
To stay on your feet for nearly the entirety of the 3+ hours. Highly recommended this tour.

We did the Colusseum, Forum, Palatine Hill tour with Serena. She went out of her way to be informative and engaging and even brought a lot of extra visual reference material she shared to enhance the experience of the tour. In addition to being a very gracious guide, who took great care of us like a "Roman Momma ," and accommodating any unique requests with grace. She's also clearly a scholar of archeology, architecture, and history. Truly a great experience. 👍

A fantastic family experience, kids (aged 14, 13 and 10) all loved iit. Serena Spalletta was an extremely knowledgeable and engaging guide, her anecdotes, use of ipad and pictures really made this amazing historic location come alive for all of us. Highly recommend

We absolutely loved this tour, it was well worth the money. Massimo, our guide, was great. He was helpful, patient, amusing and very well informed.
The group we were with was small, only ten of us, and Massimo gave us all enough time to take photographs and video.
If you are a thinking about visiting the Colosseum, then this is the tour to choose.

Underground bit was rrally good and interesting to see how it was used but the rest felt like it was more about the guide Marlene and her opinions rather than interesting facts about the Colloseum. Not enough time at the Colloseum and was told off for taking pictures. Guide compared colloseum to Auschwitz multiple times. Sniggered about people's religions etc.
At the forum we learned more from the written signs dotted around - how people used the buildings, where was a 'shopping mall' etc.
The tour might be good but I'd ask for a different guide. The Colloseum itself is great of course and always good to skip the line too.

Giavanni was a great tour guide. He did his best to shield us from the brutal heat on Palatine Hill. We had two 11 year old children with us. It’s a lot of walking so if your kids aren’t good at long and uneven terrain walking, I wouldn’t do a 3 hour tour. The underground was fascinating!

This guided tour and early access was amazing. Danielle was a terrific guide and shared key historical facts as we walked under the colleseum, on the ground floor and visited Palentine hill. Strongly recommend this tour! Early access gave us the direct entry to skip the lines.

Great tour. We learnt a lot about the history of Rome and the colosseum. We recommend it. The meeting point was clear, the tour was very organized and the guide showed a lot of interest for explaining all the details

We have just done the Colosseum tour underground, arena and forum. Our tour guide was Inga.

Absolutely brilliant and highly recommend, Inga’s historical knowledge was excellent and made this more than just a tour for us. The 3 hrs went really quickly and was well worth the money.

Thank you Inga

First time in Rome and WOW what a fantastic tour, led by Daniela who was extremely knowledgeable and passionate and made us feel part of the rich history around us. The underground tour was the highlight with new sections recently added. We are so glad we purchased this tour as we 100% got to see more than the average tour.

Pelin was an amazing guide, knew everything about all the places that we were walking by. The tour were 3 hours that went by very quickly, and were super fun and filled with valuable knowledge, that were historically accurate. Weather was amazing as well.

The tour was excellent but the weather was not (102 F in the shade). The tour guide was Gabriel and he was excellent. Very knowledgeable and made the tour go fast.
The underground at the Colosseum is the best part of the tour but to our disappointment came last. I would caution anyone taking the tour that it says in the description that the order of the attractions can be altered based on a availability of tickets to the Colosseum. My wife and I arrived at 2:30 for the 3pm tour and were shocked to learn that we would not enter the Colosseum until 4:30pm. When booking this tour take this into consideration.
Otherwise it was a good tour.

Pelin was an amazing tour guide that answered all our questions and was great at engaging the kids in the tour. We learned lots or new and interesting details that we wouldn’t have known if not on the tour and went without a guide. We would definitely recommend for people with all ages of kids.

What a day! Lea was a superb guide...the best we have ever had. She was so informative, so engaging and so caring. We had a couple of people in our group who were limited in terms of mobility but Lea made their day with her care and kindness. The tour itself was so comprehensive. It was long at over 3 hours but Lea made it so interesting that we really didn’t notice the time. Absolutely recommended.

This tour was ABSOLUTELY worth it!!! There were only 6 others on the tour and barely any others around when we toured the forum and the underground. I was lucky enough to get a phenomenal guide, Faby! She was extremely knowledgeable, genuine, and passionate. I can tell that she is doing what she absolutely loves!

Thank you Faby for a fantastic tour!

Lia did an amazing job on our tour. She was very informative and energetic. We were able to stop in some shady areas as it was very hot. The Colosseum was breathtaking. I’m glad I spent the extra money for the underground experience and being in a smaller group was nice. I highly recommend.

Sara was an amazing guide! Here passion about the history of Rome was infectious. We loved that the tour began at the beginning of the history of Rome and moved to the Flavian Amphitheater for the grand finale. The small group format was perfect. I would highly recommend this special tour and Sara.

It was a great experience. Our guide Pelin was really nice and talked a lot about the history of the Colosseum and Palatine hill. The tour was split 2h for the Colosseum and around 1h for the Palatine hill and Roman Forum.

Yesterday we enjoyed an amazing 3 hour walking tour with Serena through the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, followed by Colosseum where we went underground, on the arena floor and inside.
Serena was super fun and knowledged, she overloaded us (in a good way) with insightful information. Best choice ever to do this guided tour. Not only will you skip the line, you can access areas where you otherwise without a tour cannot go, and you get much more detailed information. The 3 hours was split 50/50, so 1,5 hours Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, and 1,5 hours in the Colloseum. Definitely recommend Serena and Touriks Tours!

This tour is definitely the way to go. You have the tickets taken care of, you have a tour guide and you're good to go. Our guide was very knowledgeable about the history that I never knew anything about. She set it up pretty well chronologically from the Palatine Hill to the Colosseum. Going underground was definitely the highlight (not to mention the shade, it was very hot, bring a hat, lots of water and sunscreen.) It was amazing to be in such a place that has lasted for hundreds of years. I am truly grateful for the experience. Thank you.
